definitions.explanation: Continuing without any pause or interruption. Describes actions, sounds, or states that persist without stopping. Can be positive (constant effort) or negative (unrelenting noise).

examples.japanese: {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない{努力|どりょく}が{実|みの}った。
{工事|こうじ}の{絶|た}え{間|ま}ない{騒音|そうおん}に{悩|なや}まされている。
examples.english: I'm troubled by the constant noise from construction.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{絶|た}え{間|ま}ない{人気|にんき}を{誇|ほこ}り、いつ{行|い}っても{行列|ぎょうれつ}ができている。
examples.english: This shop boasts unending popularity, and there is always a line no matter when you go.

notes:
USAGE:
{絶|た}え{間|ま}ない is a compound adjective formed from {絶|た}え{間|ま} (a gap or pause in continuation) + ない (without). It always modifies a noun. The adverbial form {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく is used to modify verbs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない{努力|どりょく} (ceaseless effort)
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない{騒音|そうおん} (constant noise)
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく{続|つづ}く (to continue without pause)
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく{流|なが}れる (to flow ceaselessly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない: ceaseless (emphasizes no pauses or gaps)
- {止|や}むことのない: unceasing (literary, similar meaning)
- {延々|えんえん}と: endlessly (adverb, emphasizes tedious length)
- {常|つね}に: always, constantly (neutral, factual)

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {絶|た}え{間|ま}なくなかったら
